headline: A little robot for the useful bits of your day.
description: DaBin keeps your ideas, links, images and files together on your Mac. Drop something onto the robot, keep it with a project, and find it again when you need it.

page_one.title: Hi, I'm DaBin.
page_one.intro: I keep the useful bits of your day - an idea, a link, an image or a file - so you can find them again and get back to work.
page_one.quick_start: Find me in a screen corner. Drop something onto me, press Command-V while hovering, or double-click to open.

callouts.title: Choose a project
callouts.body: Pick a home for related work. Give it a color, and I'll frame its cards to match.

callouts.title: Your three starting points
callouts.body: Inbox is for organizing. Today is for doing. Projects keeps related work together.

callouts.title: Find it again
callouts.body: Use Search when you remember a word but not where you saved it.

callouts.title: See what you saved
callouts.body: Explorer puts previews first. Open a card for its details; click a file preview there to open my saved copy.

page_one.meet_body: Move your pointer to a screen corner. Drop something onto my body, or hover over me and press Command-V. Double-click me to open DaBin.
page_one.island_note: Prefer the camera island? Choose it in Settings. On other displays, I'll use the top-right corner.

page_two.title: Save it. Find it. Pick it up again.
page_two.subtitle: You don't need to learn everything at once. Start with these three small steps.

steps.title: Save now. Sort later.
steps.body: Drop or paste something into Inbox. Open a card to add a note or choose its project.
steps.tip: Day and Week help you look back through your captures by date.

steps.title: Keep a project together.
steps.body: Choose a project, then browse its saved things in Explorer. Its color helps you spot what belongs together.
steps.tip: Use Notes for your thoughts, Clipboard for copied things, and Shelf for files you want close by.

steps.title: Give one task your attention.
steps.body: Set a task's focus time and press Play. When time's up, I hold an alarm clock and a sign with the task's first three words.
steps.tip: Click me to send me home. Your task stays open until you mark it done.

page_two.auto_body: Auto Capture is optional and off by default. In Settings, choose Clipboard, Screenshots, or both. Screenshots need a folder you choose. Only new changes are saved.
page_two.auto_tip: Check Destination in the window: new automatic captures go to that project, or Unfiled. Pause whenever you like.
page_two.comfort_body: Drag an empty spot at the top to move the window. Resize from an edge or corner, or use Expand. Hover for little hints; turn off Show tooltips in Settings if you prefer.
page_two.privacy_title: Your things stay on your Mac.
page_two.privacy_body: No account or cloud sync. Link previews only contact websites if you turn them on.
